items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Were you good friends? Yes, and I hate to say it but I sang at her funeral.

ctx.x: everybody seeing that I was going to stay, then I got - I stayed with different people. I would go to different homes.
And you did that to be comfortable, yeah. I notice somewhere where you said you were very fond of that number that Ivy Anderson used to do, 'I'm Satisfied'.
